text:
Izzy: quick experiment proposal before the weekend: change deploybot to prefer a two-stage soft-pin for runtime 3.5 -> 3.6 mismatches for models tagged `summarize-large`. hard pins are too aggressive and cause cache thrash for longseqs. cc @Marco @sre-oncall

deploybot: Signature drift detected: sdk=3.2 vs runtime=3.6. Default action queued: hard-pin runtime=3.2 (action id=pin-4167890123).

Marco: +1 to soft-pin. Proposal: stage 1 = header `X-Compat:soft-v2` on 0.7% traffic for 45m. stage 2 = if stage1 metrics OK, expand to 5% with `kv_compat_check` enabled for 2h. Only create hard-pin if token_rewrite_mismatch + error_rate exceed thresholds for 10m.

Izzy: runbook draft: rollback and pin if any of: error_rate > 1.2% sustained 10m, token_rewrite_mismatch > 0.6% 10m, or p95 latency > 2x baseline 15m. rollback command: `deployctl pin --runtime=3.2 --reason="softflow-fail-4167890123"`

sre-oncall: add deadman 25m and a manual kill-switch flag in the deploy console. i'll wire a pager rule: ops/softpin_alert -> pager if error_rate > 1% for 5m during canary. Also please emit structured `softpin.v2` events to the event bus.

Chloe: i'll prep a small SDK handshake change to return `kv_compat_estimate` and `compat_score` in the initial metadata. PR will also include a simulated preflight check for KV shape mismatches. linking PRs here when ready.

Marco: config snippet i'm proposing for deploybot (to be added to canary body):

```
{
  "soft_pin_v2": true,
  "stages": [
    {"percent": 0.7, "duration_min": 45, "compat_threshold": 0.86},
    {"percent": 5, "duration_min": 120, "kv_compat_floor": 0.72}
  ],
  "deadman_minutes": 25,
  "hard_pin_delay_min": 180
}
```

Izzy: timeline: stage1 start at 22:40 UTC tonight, stage1 -> stage2 automatic only if metrics pass. canary id will be `softpin-v2-4167890123`. Chloe, can you add the `kv_compat_estimate` to the handshake before the start?

Chloe: yes, opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1401 - adds kv_compat_estimate + unit tests. will also add a feature flag to toggle the handshake.

deploybot: Canary scheduled -> softpin-v2-4167890123 in eu-west at 22:40 UTC. logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/softpin-v2-4167890123

sre-oncall: acknowledged. i'll create dashboards: ops/softpin-v2-4167890123 and set these alerts: error_rate > 1% (5m), token_rewrite_mismatch > 0.5% (10m), p95 > 2x baseline (10m). Pager will notify @sre-oncall and @eng-releases.

Marco: ensure deploybot emits `softpin.v2` events with canary id, stage, and compat metrics to the kafka topic `release.events`. we'll need them for retrospective QC.

Izzy: notes-bot please add an item to release notes checklist with rollback command, thresholds, and PR links.

notes-bot: Created release notes draft: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/901 with checklist and runbook.

Chloe: small risk note: routing older runtime for longseqs may evict warm KV entries; i've added a temporary eviction throttle for canary nodes to keep memory pressure lower. set KVCACHE_EVICT_RATIO=0.75 for canary pool.

Marco: good call. also keep canary logs and traces for 14d. if anything looks off we revert heuristics and run the rollback command.

Izzy: launching in 10. will post quick status updates here. if stage1 is green after 45m we'll auto-expand to stage2. otherwise we pin immediately and open an incident. thanks all.
